evidence: moogly replaced most of their previous sensors with SNZB-02P units and likes the built-in magnet despite the thicker body; their three-to-four-year battery estimate is an expectation, not a measured result.

evidence_sources.author: moogly
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've replaced most of them with Sonoff SNZB-02P which runs a CR2477 battery and I expect the battery life to be at least 3 years; with some luck maybe 4? Not as slim however, but the built-in magnet makes up for it.

source_story_title: Best-selling Zigbee temperature sensors tested and compared
